_evidence: 0x0040dde6 (edi = segment record [0x866ed0] or [0x866ed4], see 0x40def9; spec rec[0x8943a0,0x160,0..3]) takes the point pair +0x118/+0x11c or +0x120/+0x124 of edi (sign of byte 0x868582) and the cursor record [edi+0x44], moves it 50 records back (pit: clamp at the pit start [0x891500]; lap: below the lap start [0x891504] add the lap length [0x866ec4]) and then visits 100 records forward (at the lap end [0x866ecc]: below the pit start subtract the lap length, at/after the pit end [0x866ef8] clamp to its last record), keeping the nearest of the other point pair (fild/fsqrt/fistp, masked: any values). Random pointers faulted every case. The single wrap is only coherent when the lap holds more than 50 records and start/end/length agree, so the lap is fixed at records 0..119 (start 0x8943a0, end base+120*0x160, length 0xa500); pit start 125..128, pit end 140..150. The cursor +0x44 of records 0..3 is any record 0..149 (lap, gap or pit; every one stays inside records 0..149), and the four position dwords of records 0..149 are varied i32 (both outcomes of the nearest-point compare).
